facts.text: Graduates of Catholic high schools are eligible for the Legacy of Service Scholarship, which awards $4,000 per year for four years.

sources.title: Types Of Aid - Chestnut Hill College
sources.quote: Legacy of Service Scholarship – $4,000 per year for 4 years First-year students who graduated from a Catholic high school are eligible to receive this annual award of $4,000 per year for 4 years.
